question.text:
Match List-I with List-II :
$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|}
\hline & \text { List-I } & & \text { List-II } \\
\hline \text { (A) } & \text { A force that restores an elastic body of unit area to its original state } & \text { (I) } & \text { Bulk modulus } \\
\hline \text { (B) } & \text { Two equal and opposite forces parallel to opposite faces } & \text { (II) } & \text { Young's modulus } \\
\hline \text { (C) } & \begin{array}{l}
\text { Forces perpendicular everywhere to the surface per unit area } \\
\text { same everywhere }
\end{array} & \text { (III) } & \text { Stress } \\
\hline \text { (D) } & \text { Two equal and opposite forces perpendicular to opposite faces } & \text { (IV) } & \text { Shear modulus } \\
\hline
\end{array}$
Choose the correct answer from the options given below :

solution.text:
(1) stress $=\frac{F_{\text {restoring }}}{A}$ If $\mathrm{A}=1$ Stress $=F_{\text {restoring }}$ (A)-(III) (2)
(B)-(IV) (3)
(C)-(I) (4)
(D)-(II)
